scripts.build: npm run build-all && npm run consolidate
scripts.build-all: npm run build-aca && npm run build-channie && npm run build-cissi && npm run build-piya
scripts.build-aca: cd "aca card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-channie: cd "channie card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-cissi: cd "cissi card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-piya: cd "piya card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.consolidate: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/images && cp index.html style.css logo.webp public/ && cp "aca card/public/aca.webp" "channie card/public/channie.webp" "cissi card/public/cissi.webp" "piya card/src/assets/piya.webp" public/images/ && cp -r "aca card/dist" public/aca-card && cp -r "channie card/dist" public/channie-card && cp -r "cissi card/dist" public/cissi-card && cp -r "piya card/dist" public/piya-card
